summary_en: 8,000,000 shares (5.89% S/O ex-treasury), ¥2.0B upper limit, ¥/share ceiling not disclosed, 1 July – 31 December 2026, open market on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Rationale: stock price level, liquidity position, and operating environment assessed to support buyback as contributor to shareholder value.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Bushiroad's board of directors resolved on 30 June 2026 to acquire up to 8,000,000 of its own ordinary shares (5.89% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥2.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the period 1 July through 31 December 2026. No per-share price ceiling was disclosed. The company cited consideration of stock price level, liquidity position, and operating environment as support for the buyback's contribution to shareholder value. At the announcement date, Bushiroad held 1,592,934 treasury shares against a total issued count of 135,888,166 shares excluding treasury.
